lens.dof: deep focus holding foreground and background equally sharp

lighting.practicals: the light sources sit inside the frame and read as part of the set

composition.movement_of_subject: subjects move along the perspective axis, toward or away from the lens

sound.ambience_bias: sparse room tone with a low mechanical hum

music.dynamics: holding one unbroken level with no swell

must_include: corridors and rooms recede to a single vanishing point
the subject is placed exactly on the centre line of the frame

notes: Symmetry, deep focus and unhurried forward movement. Composition is architectural: the room is as much the subject as the person in it.
